stages.name: imports
stages.query: SELECT "__path",NULL AS "id","__start","__end","module","alias_id","name","local" FROM (SELECT n.__path,n.id,n.__start,n.__end,n.module_name_source module,x.id alias_id,coalesce(x.name_source,x.text) name,coalesce(x.alias_source,x.name_source,x.text) local FROM nodes n JOIN nodes x ON x.__path=n.__path AND x.parent=n.id WHERE n.kind IN ('import_statement','import_from_statement') AND x.kind IN ('aliased_import','dotted_name') AND x.id IS NOT n.module_name_id)

stages.name: module_aliases
stages.query: SELECT "__path","__start","name" FROM (SELECT __path,__start,CASE WHEN module IS NULL AND name='impl.common.l2070_server_plan.plan_helpers' AND local=name THEN 'plan_helpers' ELSE local END name FROM imports WHERE module='impl.common.l2070_server_plan' AND name='plan_helpers' OR module IS NULL AND name='impl.common.l2070_server_plan.plan_helpers')

stages.name: target_names
stages.query:
SELECT "__path","assignment","id","__start","__end","name" FROM (WITH RECURSIVE targets(__path,assignment,node) AS (
         SELECT __path,id,target FROM assignments UNION ALL SELECT t.__path,t.assignment,n.id FROM targets t JOIN nodes p ON p.__path=t.__path AND p.id=t.node JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=p.__path AND n.parent=p.id WHERE p.kind IN ('pattern_list','tuple_pattern','list_pattern','tuple','list'))
         SELECT t.__path,t.assignment,n.id,n.__start,n.__end,n.text name FROM targets t JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=t.__path AND n.id=t.node WHERE n.kind='identifier')

stages.name: bindings
stages.query: SELECT "__path",NULL AS "id","name","helper","expr","at" FROM (SELECT i.__path,i.alias_id id,i.local name,i.name helper,NULL expr,i.__start at FROM imports i WHERE i.module='impl.common.l2070_server_plan.plan_helpers' AND (i.name IN (SELECT name FROM helper_names) OR i.name GLOB '_*via_plan*') UNION ALL SELECT t.__path,t.id,t.name,NULL,a.value,a.__start FROM target_names t JOIN assignments a ON a.__path=t.__path AND a.id=t.assignment WHERE a.value IS NOT NULL)

stages.name: requests
stages.query: SELECT "__path","id","expr","at" FROM (SELECT __path,id,callee_id expr,__start at FROM calls UNION ALL SELECT __path,id,value,__start FROM assignments WHERE value IS NOT NULL)

stages.name: resolved
stages.query:
SELECT "__path","request","helper" FROM (WITH RECURSIVE lookup(__path,request,node,at,helper,priority) AS (
        SELECT __path,id,expr,at,NULL,'' FROM requests
        UNION ALL
        SELECT w.__path,w.request,b.expr,b.at,b.helper,w.priority||printf('%020d/',b.at+1) FROM lookup w JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=w.__path AND n.id=w.node JOIN bindings b ON b.__path=n.__path AND b.name=n.text AND b.at<w.at WHERE w.helper IS NULL AND n.kind='identifier'
        UNION ALL
        SELECT w.__path,w.request,NULL,w.at,n.text,w.priority||'00000000000000000000/' FROM lookup w JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=w.__path AND n.id=w.node WHERE w.helper IS NULL AND n.kind='identifier' AND n.text IN (SELECT name FROM helper_names)
        UNION ALL
        SELECT w.__path,w.request,NULL,w.at,a.attr,w.priority||'00000000000000000000/' FROM lookup w JOIN attributes a ON a.__path=w.__path AND a.id=w.node JOIN nodes o ON o.__path=a.__path AND o.id=a.object WHERE w.helper IS NULL AND (a.attr IN (SELECT name FROM helper_names) OR a.attr GLOB '_*via_plan*' AND o.kind='identifier' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM module_aliases m WHERE m.__path=o.__path AND m.name=o.text AND m.__start<w.at)))
        SELECT __path,request,helper FROM (SELECT __path,request,helper,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY __path,request ORDER BY priority DESC) chosen FROM lookup WHERE helper IS NOT NULL) WHERE chosen=1)

stages.name: modules

WHEN instr('.'||replace(CASE WHEN substr(trim(rx_replace(replace(__path,char(92),'/'),'/+','/'),'/'),-3)='.py' THEN substr(trim(rx_replace(replace(__path,char(92),'/'),'/+','/'),'/'),1,length(trim(rx_replace(replace(__path,char(92),'/'),'/+','/'),'/'))-3) ELSE trim(rx_replace(replace(__path,char(92),'/'),'/+','/'),'/') END,'/','.')||'.','.api.')>0 THEN substr(replace(CASE WHEN substr(trim(rx_replace(replace(__path,char(92),'/'),'/+','/'),'/'),-3)='.py' THEN substr(trim(rx_replace(replace(__path,char(92),'/'),'/+','/'),'/'),1,length(trim(rx_replace(replace(__path,char(92),'/'),'/+','/'),'/'))-3) ELSE trim(rx_replace(replace(__path,char(92),'/'),'/+','/'),'/') END,'/','.'),instr('.'||replace(CASE WHEN substr(trim(rx_replace(replace(__path,char(92),'/'),'/+','/'),'/'),-3)='.py' THEN substr(trim(rx_replace(replace(__path,char(92),'/'),'/+','/'),'/'),1,length(trim(rx_replace(replace(__path,char(92),'/'),'/+','/'),'/'))-3) ELSE trim(rx_replace(replace(__path,char(92),'/'),'/+','/'),'/') END,'/','.')||'.','.api.')+4) ELSE coalesce(rx_extract(replace(CASE WHEN substr(trim(rx_replace(replace(__path,char(92),'/'),'/+','/'),'/'),-3)='.py' THEN substr(trim(rx_replace(replace(__path,char(92),'/'),'/+','/'),'/'),1,length(trim(rx_replace(replace(__path,char(92),'/'),'/+','/'),'/'))-3) ELSE trim(rx_replace(replace(__path,char(92),'/'),'/+','/'),'/') END,'/','.'),'(?:^|\.)(l[0-9]{4}_.*)$',1),replace(CASE WHEN substr(trim(rx_replace(replace(__path,char(92),'/'),'/+','/'),'/'),-3)='.py' THEN substr(trim(rx_replace(replace(__path,char(92),'/'),'/+','/'),'/'),1,length(trim(rx_replace(replace(__path,char(92),'/'),'/+','/'),'/'))-3) ELSE trim(rx_replace(replace(__path,char(92),'/'),'/+','/'),'/') END,'/','.')) END name FROM modules)

stages.name: regions
stages.query: SELECT "__path",NULL AS "id","name","__start","__end","kind" FROM (SELECT __path,id,name,__start,__end,'class' kind FROM classes UNION ALL SELECT f.__path,f.id,f.name,coalesce(d.__start,f.__start),f.__end,'function' FROM functions f LEFT JOIN nodes d ON d.__path=f.__path AND d.id=f.parent AND d.kind='decorated_definition')

stages.name: raw_issues
stages.query:
SELECT "__path","__start","__end","identity","kind","helper","local" FROM (SELECT i.__path,i.__start,i.__end,i.alias_id identity,'import' kind,i.name helper,i.local FROM imports i WHERE i.module='impl.common.l2070_server_plan.plan_helpers' AND (i.name IN (SELECT name FROM helper_names WHERE public OR lazy) OR i.name GLOB '_*via_plan*' OR i.name IN (SELECT name FROM helper_names WHERE legacy))
       UNION ALL SELECT t.__path,t.__start,t.__end,t.id,'alias',r.helper,t.name FROM target_names t JOIN resolved r ON r.__path=t.__path AND r.request=t.assignment
       UNION ALL SELECT c.__path,c.__start,c.__end,c.id,'call',r.helper,NULL FROM calls c JOIN resolved r ON r.__path=c.__path AND r.request=c.id)

stages.name: issues
stages.query:
SELECT "__path","__start","__end","identity",NULL AS "kind",NULL AS "helper",NULL AS "local",NULL AS "module","callsite","reason" FROM (SELECT i.*,m.name module,
       m.name||'::'||coalesce((SELECT group_concat(name,'.') FROM (SELECT name FROM regions r WHERE r.__path=i.__path AND r.__start<=i.__start AND r.__end>=i.__end ORDER BY kind,__start)),'<module>') callsite,
       CASE WHEN i.kind='call' THEN 'old or private '||helper||'() call is forbidden'
        WHEN helper IN (SELECT name FROM helper_names WHERE public) OR helper GLOB '_*via_plan*' OR i.kind='import' AND helper IN (SELECT name FROM helper_names WHERE legacy) THEN 'old or private '||helper||' '||i.kind||' is forbidden'
        WHEN helper IN (SELECT name FROM helper_names WHERE lazy) AND rx_matches(lower(local),'execute|fetch|scalar|ddl') THEN 'lazy terminal '||helper||CASE WHEN kind='import' THEN ' imported under eager alias' ELSE ' assigned to eager alias' END END reason
       FROM raw_issues i JOIN module_names m ON m.__path=i.__path WHERE NOT (i.kind='alias' AND helper IN (SELECT name FROM helper_names WHERE legacy)) AND NOT (i.kind='call' AND m.name='impl.common.l2070_server_plan.plan_helpers' AND (helper GLOB '_*via_plan*' OR helper IN (SELECT name FROM helper_names WHERE legacy))))
